summary: @servicetitan/document-title ships install-time Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it on a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header, rotated string-array decoder, hex-mangled identifiers) that is not referenced by the package's advertised React document-title API (src/index.tsx / dist/index.js). The alternate-runtime dropper pattern executes attacker-controlled code on every install under a runtime chosen to evade Node-based inspection. The package publishes under the @servicetitan/* scope and points its repository at servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib, but the shipped install path is inconsistent with a small React helper, indicating scope impersonation or account compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
